resources.string: BetterChoice: open a food product to see its A, B or C rating.
Allow BetterChoice to rate food in shopping apps

BetterChoice uses Android Accessibility for two things.

1. Show the bubble: it checks which app is in front, using window information and the app's package name, so the bubble appears only in Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy, Swiggy Instamart, Zomato and Flipkart.

2. Rate food: while one of those apps is open, it reads the text on product pages. For each food product it sends the product name, the shop's product type and the app's name to the BetterChoice database, which returns that product's nutrition and the better choices in its category. Nothing else from your screen is sent, no screenshot is taken, and your account and health answers are not sent: the choices that suit you are picked on this phone. Screen text is processed in memory and discarded straight away; it is never saved or used to build a shopping history. The database's answers are kept in this app's private storage for up to 24 hours, so a product you open again shows at once; they are deleted when you turn BetterChoice off. Password fields are never read, and payment screens are never rated.

Products not yet in the BetterChoice database are not rated. You can skip any item. Your email or phone number and optional profile are handled by our sign-in and profile service. BetterChoice does not read the content of other apps, messages or passwords, and never taps or types for you.

Next, choose BetterChoice DB bubble in Android Accessibility settings and switch it on. You can withdraw consent with Turn off BetterChoice or by disabling it in Settings.

Keep the BetterChoice DB bubble service on in Accessibility settings. Leave its optional shortcut off. If a button stays at the edge of your Home screen, open Manage or disable access, select BetterChoice DB bubble and turn off only its shortcut. The BC bubble works automatically while you shop.

Works only inside Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy, Swiggy Instamart, Zomato and Flipkart. Android sends it nothing from any other app, and it never opens another app\'s screen. There it shows the BetterChoice bubble and rates packaged food A, B or C. On product pages it reads the product name and type, and looks them up in the BetterChoice database. It takes no screenshots. Screen content is not saved or uploaded; only the product name, its type and the app are sent. Never reads password fields, and never rates payment screens. Never taps or types for you.

Sign-in: your email or mobile number is sent to our sign-in service (Supabase) to deliver a one-time code and create or access your account. Email and SMS providers deliver the code.

Profile: every answer is optional. Saved answers sync to your account and are encrypted in this app's private storage. You can edit or clear them, sign out, or delete your account.

Ratings: after you separately allow Accessibility, BetterChoice reads food product pages only inside the supported shopping apps. Each food product's name, type and app are looked up in the BetterChoice database; nothing else from your screen is sent or stored, and the choices that suit your answers are picked on this phone.

BetterChoice is for adults 18+. Ratings are a guide based on published nutrient scoring, not medical advice. No advertising or selling of your data.

For beta support or privacy requests, contact the person who invited you to test BetterChoice.
